## Glyphling 1.1.2

Download `Glyphling-Setup-1.1.2.exe` below and run it. It updates an existing installation in place, keeping settings, themes and position.

### Fixes
- **Nothing playing is now a still empty state.** The music panel treated "Nothing playing" as a one-second track that started over and over, redrawing the panel forever. It now shows only the message: no progress bar, no times, no play toggle, and nothing is redrawn.
- A track with an unknown duration (for example a live stream) no longer restarts itself every second.
- The source label ("No app") is only rewritten when it actually changes.

The setup is not signed yet: Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch ("More info" → "Run anyway"). Glyphling is not affiliated with Nothing.
